company.name: Dayflow
company.shortDescription: AI Daily Planner for users with ADHD
company.description:
DayFlow is an AI-powered daily planner app developed by 42apps, designed specifically to support neurodivergent individuals, including those with ADHD, in managing their daily tasks, routines, and schedules more effectively. Leveraging advanced artificial intelligence, DayFlow creates personalized, adaptive daily plans that help users prioritize tasks, reduce cognitive overload, and maintain consistent routines without feeling overwhelmed.

The app features intuitive visual task management, customizable gentle reminders, and seamless integration with popular calendar platforms such as Google Calendar and Apple Calendar. DayFlow’s user-centric design emphasizes simplicity, accessibility, and inclusivity, making it an ideal productivity tool for neurodivergent users seeking smarter ways to organize their lives.

Founded by 42apps, a software development company committed to creating innovative AI-driven productivity solutions, DayFlow reflects the company’s mission to empower individuals through technology that understands and adapts to diverse cognitive needs. Available across iOS, Android, and web platforms, DayFlow continues to evolve based on active user feedback and ongoing technological advancements.
